user.title: Set up Blitzer.de
user.description: Choose a name and whether to monitor a radius or a route corridor.

data_description.name: A short name used to identify this monitored area or route in Home Assistant.
data_description.search_mode: Choose a circular area or a waypoint-based route corridor.

area.title: Area search
area.description: Choose the center, radius and camera filters.

data_description.mobile: Include temporary or mobile speed-camera reports.

data.update_interval: Update interval in minutes (0 = manual only)

data_description.count: Maximum number of camera entities exposed for this entry.
data_description.selector: Optional regular expression matched against the reported city name.
data_description.condition: Ignore community reports that are not confirmed. Permanent fixed cameras are treated as confirmed.
data_description.update_interval: Minutes between automatic refreshes. Use 0 to refresh only through the action.
data_description.new_minutes: How long a report is highlighted and counted as new. Use 0 to disable new-report counting.
data_description.blacklist: Comma-separated camera IDs that should always be ignored.

data_description.location: Move the map marker and choose the radius Home Assistant should monitor.

waypoint.title: Add waypoint {count}
waypoint.description: Move the marker to waypoint {count}. Add at least two points. The corridor follows straight lines between points, so add waypoints on important bends.

data_description.location: Place this waypoint on the route you want to monitor.
data_description.add_another: Keep this enabled to add another waypoint after saving this point.

route_options.title: Route corridor settings
route_options.description: Choose the corridor width around the route and which camera reports to include.
